messages:
maria-support: Received a customer report: calls to /v1/toolcall are returning 400 schema errors after they renamed their tool from `pdf-generator` -> `pdfGen`. They see 'unknown tool' in response body.
maria-support: Customer says they hit it intermittently; sometimes the old alias still resolves successfully then later 400s.
devin-eng-runtime: rough guess: registry rename propagation + casefold mismatch. Can you paste the failing request headers and tool handle?
maria-support: Here's request (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/toolcall
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
X-Tenant: tenant-alpha
{
  "tool": "PDFGen",
  "args": {"url":"https://..."}
}
```

Response:
```
400 {"error":"tool_not_found","message":"no tool matched 'PDFGen'"}
```

Note: customer said UI shows new name `pdfGen` (camelCase) and older `pdf-generator` still listed in registry.
devin-eng-runtime: ah — tenant prefix + case differences. We recently changed alias canonicalization to NFC + lowercasing for new registrations but old aliases were stored legacy-case. If cache TTL hasn't expired, clients can bounce between two variants.
priya-sre: I see traffic spikes and some 504s from router when the cache invalidation job runs — might be causing partial reads. Adding @ops-bot to check registry sync logs.
ops-bot: registry-sync: job_start 2234567885, scanned 1200 aliases, updated 2 entries, inconsistent_tombstones=1
devin-eng-runtime: That inconsistent_tombstones=1 is suspicious — could be tombstone left for the old alias causing lookup to fail when routing falls back to tenant-scoped resolver.
maria-support: Customer repro steps: 1) Call with tool `PDFGen` UID  -> 400. 2) Call with `pdf-generator` -> 200. They want their app to not break.
devin-eng-runtime: Short-term workaround: recommend calling the canonical UUID (tool_id) instead of name, or include alias list in request `{"aliases":["pdfGen","pdf-generator"]}` if supported.
lucy-support: I'll send a patch note to the customer: recommend switching to `pdf-generator` for stability while we remediate. Also asking for request-id from failed call.
maria-support: attaching server trace id: trace=tr-0a1b2c3d; request-id=rid-9988
devin-eng-runtime: I'll grep logs for rid-9988. Also adding a quick check to the registry backfill: normalize existing aliases to lower ascii fold and re-index tombstones. Will push a fix to runbook.
priya-sre: Plan: 1) run immediate reindex job with dry-run; 2) if low changes, apply fix; 3) monitor for 10m; 4) notify customer. ETA 45m. if not safe, revert.
maria-support: Customer ok with 45m window. Will update them. :thumbsup:
